content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑sugar chocolate milk is made from whole cow’s milk and cocoa powder. The lower sugar content makes the drink less sweet while preserving a creamy texture and classic chocolate flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sugar is typically reduced by 30‑40 % compared with regular chocolate milk.
The cocoa powder used is often enriched with antioxidants – flavonoids.
Whole milk provides higher levels of calcium and vitamin D than skimmed milk.
The beverage is marketed as a better option for children and active adults looking to cut sugar.
In some countries the product is certified as “low‑sugar” according to national regulations.

items.title: Rich in calcium
items.content: Whole milk is a good source of calcium, which supports bone and tooth health.

items.title: Contains vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D enhances calcium absorption and supports immune function.

items.title: Cocoa flavonoids
items.content: Flavonoids have antioxidant properties and may contribute to cardiovascular health.

items.title: Reduced sugar content
items.content: Lower sugar helps control blood glucose levels and reduces the risk of dental caries.

items.title: Protein and fats
items.content: Whole milk provides a complete set of proteins and healthy fats needed for growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort after consuming the product.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey requires complete avoidance of dairy products.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: Whole milk contains saturated fats; those monitoring fat intake should consider overall daily balance.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although reduced, the product still contains carbohydrates, which is important for diabetics.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Chocolate milk can be enjoyed cold as a refreshing drink, added to smoothies, used in desserts, or poured over pancakes and waffles. For children, serve in modest portions.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 1‑4 °C. After opening, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
